steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Anything else I can help with?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: No, my friend is coming. She'll take care of the rest.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: I came as soon as I heard. What happened? Let me take a look.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hey, don't grab my head. And don't lift my skirt with so many people watching.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Well, you look alive enough.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Thanks to these two. They helped me when I had a flare-up.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Just doing what any doctor should.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: There aren't many doctors like you left. Most can't run away fast enough when they find out about our condition.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: If you're here to take care of her, then we'll be leaving.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Wait! Here's my card. Please feel free to visit my massage parlor any time. 20% off for you amigos!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Thank you, but I don't think we'll need—

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: She's good, you know. Whenever we get an ache or pain, all of us go right to her.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I'm a physician, I know how to take care of myself. I don't need any help.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Just try it, sir.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Please, keep your distance, ma'am.
The woman takes a few steps back, puts on a pair of gloves, then snaps her fingers.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Sure. I can do it from this distance.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: You can touch me from there?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Ahem... I've heard of people claiming the ability to perform therapy from afar. Whether it's called 'Qi' or some other name, most research indicates that it's pseudoscie—
As the woman's fingers move through the air, the pair feel a warm sensation on their shoulders, and soon feel a sense of comfort that envelopes them gently.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Oh... my stress and anxiety... all gone...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Am I imagining it? I feel so good... oh...

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Well... I guess I can forget the research...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: What? Someone stole the meds?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: This is no joke, Ernesto. We have a lot of Infected in the community who need those meds.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: We apologize for failing to deliver. We'll try to make up for it.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You don't really think money will do it, do you?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: If we can't find the meds, I'll try to obtain an equivalent amount of medicine in a timely manner.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Sorry, Señor Ernesto. I'm just nervous.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Did you see the robbers? We have plenty of eyes and ears here. Maybe we can help.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: That's what felt strange. It looked like a prepared ambush. Rhodes Island has always treaded carefully around here, trying not to make enemies...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I can't imagine why anyone would target us.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Maybe they had their eyes on your meds. Suppressants fetch a good price on the black market.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: They were very professional. Quick and efficient.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Are our meds really worth that kind of effort? And also, I think I heard the sound of gunfire while we were running.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Guns... pros, again. I'm glad Reynell thinks so highly of us.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: You think someone is targeting your community?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Our grudge with Reynell goes back a long way. But I never thought he would do something so dirty...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: What's with the commotion downstairs?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Sounds like someone's condition flared up while they were outside and got help from kind passersby. People are gathering to thank them.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: We always repay acts of kindness. Let me see their faces...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Say, haven't I seen them before?
The man picks up yesterday's newspaper and flips to the gossip section, pausing at its title: 'No one can stand him! Reynell changes bodyguards AGAIN.'
Subtitle: 'Exclusive report: Four guards, two shifts? Who are they?'

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Hey... they look really like the ones down there.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Looks like we really have to 'repay' their 'kindness.'

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I feel like I've been born again... It's hard to describe.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Thank you... It's such an astonishing massage technique.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: I learned it in Kjerag. I had to climb Mt. Karlan in a snowstorm to convince the Saintess there to teach me.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Pah, you came here from Siracusa what, seven or eight years ago? When did you have the time to go to the Snow Realm? Don't believe her tall tales.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Hey, I resent the accusation!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Well, thank you for the massage. But we should go—
Reynell has a lot of people working for him. A couple less won't make any difference.
How about you stay a little while longer and enjoy our hospitality?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá? What's the matter?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Why are you with these medicine robbers? Why did you bring them here?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: ...Medicine?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Yes, medicine for Oripathy! They stole it!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Stole? It couldn't be them! They don't even know what Oripathy is!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: We don't know anything about any medicine. Could there be a misunderstanding?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Misunderstanding? Who else but Blacksteel and you dress like mercenaries and use guns in these parts?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We were just bringing the girl back.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Well, if there's a misunderstanding, we'll clear it up. Take them in!
The duo see Diaz's aide raise his staff.
While they cannot imagine how the light at the tip of the staff would do damage, they instinctively sense the approaching danger.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Run, Kateb!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Come on, you gun-toting thugs! I dare you to set foot in this neighborhood!

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: You were too fast, I couldn't catch you. Where are they?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Hiding.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: What are you doing standing there? Find them!

steps.name: Diaz's Aide
steps.text: Move, move!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What was that? Magic?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I think they called it Originium Arts. But I guess magic is fine.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: We need to find a way out. The exits are all guarded.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Cover me. I'll control the replicate.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Ready.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Gemini Replicator active.

steps.name: Confused Community Resident
steps.text: Hey, where did they go?

steps.name: Lazy Community Resident
steps.text: Not here, not there...

steps.name: Confused Community Resident
steps.text: Where did she come from?!

steps.name: Confused Community Resident
steps.text: Right in the middle of the road!
Bows, crossbows, launchers, Arts Units... all sorts of weapons point towards the gemini decoy in the middle of the road.
Even Iana is speechless at the reception.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Well... talk about a warm welcome.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Bows, crossbows, bombs, 'magic'... hmph.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Let's go while they're distracted by the decoy. It won't take long for them to figure it out.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Maybe we should get in touch with Ela, see what's going on. I'm just so confused right now...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No, I'm sure it's not Reynell's guys. His guards have been busy getting whipped by Shuhrat.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Are you sure he's telling the truth?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'm sure. He hasn't had a chance to give an order like that today.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: But the people here seem sure that we stole their medicine.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: That's not important. What's important is that we get out of that neighborhood ASAP...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: It's dangerous for you two to continue, given their special powers. Do you need support?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: No. Their Originium Arts are impressive, but they're just a disorganized mob. I know how to protect myself, and Kateb's here with me.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: ...Get in touch if anything happens.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: They've dispersed, Meijer. Time to move.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Okay, let's go.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Alright, I've taken a look from up high. The district is roughly divided into three areas: the outer ring, the residential district, and that building at the center.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Which is always patrolled by guys with magic wands. There must be someone or something important there.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: That's not important. We're steering well clear of it anyway.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: What about going through the residential area? I didn't see anyone armed. It seems to be a safe path.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Or it could be more dangerous.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: True... common sense doesn't apply to this planet.

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: Wah—Wah—

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: Don't cry, babe, daddy will sing you a song.

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: Where are you flying, tired fowlbeast♪

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: Towards tomorrow's wind♪

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: Don't you know♪

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: Your wings are for today♪

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: (Whisper) Asleep, finally...

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I didn't think I would hear a song like that here.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Yikes!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Something just dashed past my feet. Rat, snail... I'm not sure. It's too dark.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: This is their garbage dump. No wonder no one comes here.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: The way out is just ahead. You should be glad that people don't come to this stink heap.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Hostiles?!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: No, just light from that window.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Why would they do this in their own home?

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Left
steps.text: Oh, thank you so much, honey. That fowlbeast just kept running.

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Left
steps.text: Well, it's not running anymore. Now we can—

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Left
steps.text: Oh no, it's waking up again! Arts like that just don't work here!

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Left
steps.text: (Loud fowlbeast crowing)

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: Oh no, she's waking up again!

steps.name: Sound from Window on the Right
steps.text: (Loud baby crying)

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Ha...

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I guess Originium Arts isn't the answer to everything.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Look at the colored acrylic boards on the walls. Only people who think of this place as home would put up decorations with no practical use like those.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Same goes for the graffiti on this side. The scenes, figures and decorations don't look like casual doodles.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Every picture seems to tell a story.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Wh-What are you doing here?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Er, girl, we...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Calm down. We didn't do what that gentleman accused us of... It's a misunderstanding.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I... I don't know. You helped me, but...

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: We mean no harm... You know that, girl.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Go right once you leave the alley. The left side may look empty, but sometimes Papá goes out there to smoke.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: I was just taking out the trash. I didn't see anything.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Whisper) We should go, Kateb.
